conditions: Principal Li2; antiderivatives may differ by a constant on each connected domain interval.
3*x/2 is not an integer multiple of 2*pi
ln and Li2 use their principal complex branches.
Antiderivatives are required on every connected interval between the excluded points; intervalwise constants are immaterial.
x is real, including every zero of sin(x) and cos(x).
sqrt is the nonnegative real square root; intervalwise additive constants are allowed.
